title: Tour the side bar
summary: The bar on the right is on every screen: each button opens its own thing without leaving where you are.

steps.title: Open the bar
steps.details: If it's closed, it's the little tab at the top right.

steps.title: Quick access
steps.details: From top to bottom: patient, branch, cash register, TV, charge, alerts, exchange rate, inbox, notes and the assistant.

steps.title: Patient
steps.details: You search for a patient and open their quick record.

steps.title: Branch
steps.details: The branch you work at (if there's more than one).

steps.title: Cash register
steps.details: Your cash register's status: open or closed.

steps.title: Alerts
steps.details: What's pending in the Alerts Center.

steps.title: Assistant
steps.details: If you hid the mascot, it's asleep here.

steps.title: Close the bar
steps.details: A tab stays at the top right and lets you know when something new comes in.
